British Savate Assaut Champions 2017

Results of the 2017 British Savate Assaut Championships, held on the 6th May in Farncombe, Surrey.

Congratulations to the Champions and Vice-Champions:
M150
Champion: Judah Wheeler (London)
Vice Champion: Tom Handley (London)

M85
Champion: Kalle Heinola (Oxford)
Vice Champion: Jon Schwochert (London)

M80
Champion: James Southwood (London)
Vice Champion: Charlie Howes (Guildford)

M75
Champion: James Antill (Guildford)
Vice Champion: Adam Malins (Cambridge)

M70
Champion: James Plaistowe (Guildford)
Vice Champion: Chris Naylor (White Tiger Martial Arts)

M65
Champion: Ben Alderson (Cambridge)
Vice Champion: Dominic Frederick-Allen (City Combat)

F60
Champion: Rachel Shore (Guildford)
Vice Champion: Sian-Marie Frosini (City Combat)

Thanks to Guildford Savate for hosting us, all of our hard working officials, and to all the fighters from Brighton Savate, Cambridge Savate, City Combat Savate, Dorset Savate, Guildford Savate, London Savate, Oxford Savate and White Tiger Martial Arts for travelling to contest the titles!
